en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Two versions of a courting song; 'јас кај тебе Ристе на душа' in version one is my reading (roughly 'with you, at heart'). Origin unclear, treated as traditional.

words_to_learn.en: gives alms for the soul of the dead

lines.cyr: - Елај Ристе, елај у назе,
lines.lat: - Elaj Riste, elaj u naze,
lines.en: - Come, Riste, come to our place,

lines.cyr: мајка ми ќе оди на цркви.
lines.lat: majka mi ḱe odi na crkvi.
lines.en: my mother will go to church.

lines.cyr: Таму ќе раздава за душа,
lines.lat: Tamu ḱe razdava za duša,
lines.en: There she will give alms for the soul,

lines.cyr: јас кај тебе Ристе на душа.
lines.lat: jas kaj tebe Riste na duša.
lines.en: and I, Riste, will be with you, at heart.

lines.cyr: Елај, ела Ристе до вечер,
lines.lat: Elaj, ela Riste do večer,
lines.en: Come, come, Riste, by evening,

lines.cyr: ќе те чекам Ристе под пенџер.
lines.lat: ḱe te čekam Riste pod pendžer.
lines.en: I will wait for you, Riste, under the window.

lines.cyr: Мајка ми ќе оди на гости,
lines.lat: Majka mi ḱe odi na gosti,
lines.en: My mother will go visiting,

lines.cyr: јас со тебе Ристе крај порти.
lines.lat: jas so tebe Riste kraj porti.
lines.en: I will be with you, Riste, by the gate.

lines.cyr: - Елај Ристе, елај у назе,
lines.lat: - Elaj Riste, elaj u naze,
lines.en: - Come, Riste, come to our place,

lines.cyr: јелај Ристе, јелај ју назе.
lines.lat: jelaj Riste, jelaj ju naze.
lines.en: come, Riste, come to our place.

lines.cyr: - Нејќам Доно, нејќам, не идам,
lines.lat: - Nejḱam Dono, nejḱam, ne idam,
lines.en: - I don't want to, Dona, I won't come,

lines.cyr: нејќам севдо нејќам, не идам, не идам.
lines.lat: nejḱam sevdo nejḱam, ne idam, ne idam.
lines.en: I don't want to, love, I won't come, I won't come.

lines.cyr: Мајка ти е дома, Донке ле,
lines.lat: Majka ti e doma, Donke le,
lines.en: Your mother is at home, Donka, oh,

lines.cyr: мајка ти е дома, севдо ле.
lines.lat: majka ti e doma, sevdo le.
lines.en: your mother is at home, love, oh.

lines.cyr: - Мајка ми отиде на црква,
lines.lat: - Majka mi otide na crkva,
lines.en: - My mother went to church,

lines.cyr: мајка ми отиде на црква, на црква.
lines.lat: majka mi otide na crkva, na crkva.
lines.en: my mother went to church, to church.

lines.cyr: Да раздава, Ристе, за душа,
lines.lat: Da razdava, Riste, za duša,
lines.en: To give alms, Riste, for the soul,

lines.cyr: да раздава, Ристе, за душа, за душа,
lines.lat: da razdava, Riste, za duša, za duša,
lines.en: to give alms, Riste, for the soul, for the soul,

lines.cyr: ние со тебе Ристе под круша, под круша.
lines.lat: nie so tebe Riste pod kruša, pod kruša.
lines.en: and you and I, Riste, under the pear tree, under the pear tree.

lines.cyr: Татко ми отиде в' планина,
lines.lat: Tatko mi otide v' planina,
lines.en: My father went to the mountain,

lines.cyr: татко ми отиде в' планина, в' планина,
lines.lat: tatko mi otide v' planina, v' planina,
lines.en: my father went to the mountain, to the mountain,

lines.cyr: ние со тебе Ристе в' градина,
lines.lat: nie so tebe Riste v' gradina,
lines.en: and you and I, Riste, in the garden,

lines.cyr: ние со тебе Ристе в' градина, в' градина.
lines.lat: nie so tebe Riste v' gradina, v' gradina.
lines.en: and you and I, Riste, in the garden, in the garden.

lines.cyr: - Ќе разберат горно селаните,
lines.lat: - Ḱe razberat gorno selanite,
lines.en: - The upper villagers will find out,

lines.cyr: ќе се смеат севдо душманите, душманите.
lines.lat: ḱe se smeat sevdo dušmanite, dušmanite.
lines.en: the enemies will laugh, love, the enemies.

lines.cyr: - Кога ќе разберат селаните,
lines.lat: - Koga ḱe razberat selanite,
lines.en: - When the villagers find out,

lines.cyr: ние ќе смениме прстените, прстените.
lines.lat: nie ḱe smenime prstenite, prstenite.
lines.en: we will exchange rings, the rings.
